short: A supply pod struck the library module; the Commerce Office, out of thrift, left my repair waiting, so the terminal remembers for me.
question: Why won't you just tell me the numbers from memory?
reply:
A supply pod struck the library module and broke my memory. The Commerce Office put off my repair, so the terminal remembers for me.

I can look up any figure you like. What would you like to see?
